title: ForgeRTP
description: ForgeRTP is a lightweight server-side random teleport mod for Minecraft Forge 1.7.10, allowing players to safely teleport to random wilderness locations within a fully configurable radius.
body:
ForgeRTP adds a simple, configurable random teleport system to Forge 1.7.10 servers.

Players can use `/rtp` to teleport to a safe random location within a configurable minimum and maximum radius around a customizable center point. The mod automatically searches for a safe landing location, avoiding dangerous terrain such as lava, water, cactus, fire, and other unsafe blocks based on your configuration.

Everything is configurable through an easy-to-edit config file, including teleport radius, cooldowns, maximum search attempts, allowed dimensions, biome and dimension blacklists, and various safety checks.

ForgeRTP also includes an optional persistent usage limit system, allowing server owners to restrict how many successful random teleports each player may use. Usage counts are tracked by UUID, saved across server restarts, and can be reset or inspected with administrator commands.

### Features

* Safe random teleportation
* Configurable minimum and maximum teleport radius
* Customizable teleport center
* Configurable cooldowns
* Automatic safe location detection
* Biome and dimension blacklists
* Optional persistent per-player teleport usage limits
* Administrator commands for configuration reloads and usage management
